source_text: In March 2024, National Assembly Member Fatoumata Ceesay-Jallow introduced a private member's bill to repeal sections of the 2015 Act banning FGM, arguing it violated cultural and religious norms; the assembly voted 31-4 to advance it for debate despite committee recommendations against. [37]
